name: FrenchModelVariant153_HandleRequest

notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the US header-136/266 and Japanese images build the same source through model_variant/variant153_entry_usa.c (VARIANT153_PRINT_WORK_SIZE adds the work-size printf), with the US images binding gFrenchModelVariant153_UnitScale 0xC higher; gFrenchModelVariant153_aImages, gFrenchModelVariant153_aConfigs 0x1C higher than the French images (notes/overlays/usa-model-french-entries.md). HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
